the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is an amalgam separator?

Amalgam separators are devices designed to capture amalgam particles from dental office wastewater
through sedimentation, filtration, centrifugation, or a combination of these mechanisms.

The separator works by using a filtration system that separates the solid waste containing dental
amalgam from the wastewater generated during dental procedures. This helps prevent the release of
mercury and other metals into the environment and water systems, thereby reducing environmental
contamination.

Regulatory bodies in many regions mandate the use of amalgam separators in dental offices to ensure
proper disposal and handling of dental amalgam waste, thereby contributing to environmental
protection and human health safety.

Do I need an amalgam separator to comply with regulations?

To comply with the regulations, dental practices (both existing and new) require amalgam separation
units to be installed and ensure the amalgam collected is disposed of in accordance with the
regulations.

Many countries and regions have implemented regulations mandating the use of amalgam separators in
dental practices to manage and control the disposal of dental amalgam waste.

For instance, in the United Kingdom, the UK government has enforced regulations regarding the
installation and use of amalgam separators in dental practices. The specific requirements,
guidelines, and enforcement of these regulations may differ based on the local environmental agency
or governing bodies overseeing dental waste management.

It’s essential to consult with the environmental regulatory bodies, dental associations, or relevant
authorities in your area to understand the specific requirements concerning the use of amalgam
separators. They can provide accurate information on whether it’s mandatory and the specifications
for compliance with regulations regarding dental amalgam waste management in dental practices.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is an amalgam separator?

Amalgam separators are devices designed to capture amalgam particles from dental office wastewater
through sedimentation, filtration, centrifugation, or a combination of these mechanisms.

The separator works by using a filtration system that separates the solid waste containing dental
amalgam from the wastewater generated during dental procedures. This helps prevent the release of
mercury and other metals into the environment and water systems, thereby reducing environmental
contamination.

Regulatory bodies in many regions mandate the use of amalgam separators in dental offices to ensure
proper disposal and handling of dental amalgam waste, thereby contributing to environmental
protection and human health safety.

Do I need an amalgam separator to comply with regulations?

To comply with the regulations, dental practices (both existing and new) require amalgam separation
units to be installed and ensure the amalgam collected is disposed of in accordance with the
regulations.

Many countries and regions have implemented regulations mandating the use of amalgam separators in
dental practices to manage and control the disposal of dental amalgam waste.

For instance, in the United Kingdom, the UK government has enforced regulations regarding the
installation and use of amalgam separators in dental practices. The specific requirements,
guidelines, and enforcement of these regulations may differ based on the local environmental agency
or governing bodies overseeing dental waste management.

It’s essential to consult with the environmental regulatory bodies, dental associations, or relevant
authorities in your area to understand the specific requirements concerning the use of amalgam
separators. They can provide accurate information on whether it’s mandatory and the specifications
for compliance with regulations regarding dental amalgam waste management in dental practices.

Environmentally Responsible Dental Wastewater Solutions

## Protecting water while making compliance easier for dental offices.

Anterior Quest is committed to providing environmentally friendly and healthy evacuation system
solutions. Our award-winning HG Containment System is designed to capture dental wastewater, help
eliminate mercury from entering the wastewater stream, and reduce the burden placed on dental office
staff.

Unlike traditional separator systems that require staff to handle filters and waste materials,
Anterior Quest provides a hands-off service. Our team removes collected amalgam waste, transports it
to a centralized treatment facility, and processes it through a controlled treatment system.
[ Contact US ][15] [ Learn More ][16]
🌊

### Water Preservation

Designed to help keep dental mercury out of the wastewater stream and protect one of our most
valuable resources.


✅

### Simple Compliance

Helps dental practices manage wastewater responsibly while reducing internal handling and
maintenance concerns.

🦷

### Hands-Off Service

Our staff handles removal, transport, treatment, and support so your team can stay focused on
patient care.

How It Works

## A cleaner process from collection to treatment.

Anterior Quest gives dental offices a managed solution for collecting, transporting, and treating
amalgam waste without disrupting daily operations.

### Containment

A patented, maintenance-free amalgam containment system that captures and safely manages dental
mercury and amalgam waste.

[ Learn More ][17]

### Collection

Our staff arrives at the dental office and removes collected amalgam waste from the containment
system.

### Transport

Waste is transported by Anterior Quest to a centralized treatment facility without contact from
office staff.

### Treatment

Wastewater is processed, tested, and treated to help ensure only clean water is released back into
the system.

# Dental wastewater products built for simple compliance.

[ Shop Products ][13] [ View Featured ][14]

Environmentally Responsible Dental Wastewater Solutions

## Protecting water while making compliance easier for dental offices.

Anterior Quest is committed to providing environmentally friendly and healthy evacuation system
solutions. Our award-winning HG Containment System is designed to capture dental wastewater, help
eliminate mercury from entering the wastewater stream, and reduce the burden placed on dental office
staff.

Unlike traditional separator systems that require staff to handle filters and waste materials,
Anterior Quest provides a hands-off service. Our team removes collected amalgam waste, transports it
to a centralized treatment facility, and processes it through a controlled treatment system.
[ Contact US ][15] [ Learn More ][16]
🌊

### Water Preservation

Designed to help keep dental mercury out of the wastewater stream and protect one of our most
valuable resources.


✅

### Simple Compliance

Helps dental practices manage wastewater responsibly while reducing internal handling and
maintenance concerns.

🦷

### Hands-Off Service

Our staff handles removal, transport, treatment, and support so your team can stay focused on
patient care.

How It Works

## A cleaner process from collection to treatment.

Anterior Quest gives dental offices a managed solution for collecting, transporting, and treating
amalgam waste without disrupting daily operations.

### Containment

A patented, maintenance-free amalgam containment system that captures and safely manages dental
mercury and amalgam waste.

[ Learn More ][17]

### Collection

Our staff arrives at the dental office and removes collected amalgam waste from the containment
system.

### Transport

Waste is transported by Anterior Quest to a centralized treatment facility without contact from
office staff.

### Treatment

Wastewater is processed, tested, and treated to help ensure only clean water is released back into
the system.

## 909,000

Since 2013, Anterior Quest has helped recycle dental wastewater and prevent mercury from entering
the environment, preserving millions of acres of freshwater for future generations.

## New Dental Board Rules Start June 30

The Colorado Dental Board split their Sunset Review rulemaking adoption into two separate meetings,
one on April 30 (rules go into effect June 30), another on July 8.

## July 1 Changes to State Funded Programs

across the board cut of 2% to Medicaid rates. Additional cuts were also made.

## Company Overview

Henan Daswell Machinery Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer and trader specializing in the research,
development and production of construction machinery for nearly 30 years. Nowadays, we specialize in
the following machines: concrete batching plant, twin shaft concrete mixer, planetary concrete
mixer, diesel concrete mixer,concrete pump, etc. We successfully passed CE certificate and ISO
9001:2000 quality management certificate. Zero-tolerance for inferiority is our principle, all
products must be test before leaving our factory. With our strict quality control, many new
customers choose us. With our outstanding customers service, lots of regular customers are satisfied
with us. we have gained a global sales network reaching in Colombia, Bolivia, Brazil, Venezuela,
Ecuador, Russia, Philippines, Vietnam, Libya, Ghana, etc. In the tenet of Quality, Service and
Excellence, DASWELL MACHINERY is looking forward to cooperation with new and regular customers all
around the world.

# Why Use Dental Community Compliance?

Incorporating Dental Community Compliance into your practice ensures not only regulatory compliance,
but also enhanced organization, streamlined processes, and improved team dynamics. Join us in
simplifying your compliance journey and ensuring the success of your dental practice.

## Compliance Dashboard

Utilize our compliance dashboard to gain an insightful overview of your practice's compliance
status. Get a rapid overview of upcoming, overdue, and completed tasks by your team, offering you
peace of mind by ensuring your team stays on track with their responsibilities. The dashboard
enables you and your team to effortlessly access tasks, manuals, continuing education (CE) training,
online Safety Data Sheets (SDS), fillable forms, stock supply expiration and more.

[Learn More][21] [Book a Demo][22]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## Compliance Calendar

Say goodbye to compliance headaches with our intuitive compliance calendar. Our platform keeps you
on track by highlighting all necessary compliance tasks, from OSHA regulations to HIPAA
requirements, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. Receive timely reminders for upcoming tasks
and stay informed about overdue items, all in one convenient dashboard. With our platform,
compliance has never been easier.

[Learn More][23] [Book a Demo][24]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## SDS Storage

With our innovative SDS sheet storage feature, accessing safety data sheets has never been easier.
Say goodbye to bulky binders and hello to convenient digital access. Stay compliant with confidence,
knowing your SDS forms are available offline even when internet is not available. Our user-friendly
interface ensures effortless navigation, allowing you to quickly locate and review SDS information
with just a few clicks. Experience peace of mind knowing that essential safety information is
readily available at your fingertips, empowering you to make informed decisions and maintain a safe
working environment.

[Learn More][25] [Book a Demo][26]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## CE Courses

Our platform offers essential trainings in OSHA, HIPAA, Infection Control, and more, tailored
specifically for dental offices. With each module, your staff can effortlessly access training
videos followed by interactive quizzes to ensure understanding. Upon completion, our system
automatically generates Continuing Education (CE) certificates, securely stored in individual staff
files. Stay compliant, stress-free, and focused on what matters most – providing exceptional care to
your patients.

[Learn More][27] [Book a Demo][28]

## Compliance Dashboard

Utilize our compliance dashboard to gain an insightful overview of your practice's compliance
status. Get a rapid overview of upcoming, overdue, and completed tasks by your team, offering you
peace of mind by ensuring your team stays on track with their responsibilities. The dashboard
enables you and your team to effortlessly access tasks, manuals, continuing education (CE) training,
online Safety Data Sheets (SDS), fillable forms, stock supply expiration and more.

[Learn More][21] [Book a Demo][22]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## Compliance Calendar

Say goodbye to compliance headaches with our intuitive compliance calendar. Our platform keeps you
on track by highlighting all necessary compliance tasks, from OSHA regulations to HIPAA
requirements, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. Receive timely reminders for upcoming tasks
and stay informed about overdue items, all in one convenient dashboard. With our platform,
compliance has never been easier.

[Learn More][23] [Book a Demo][24]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## SDS Storage

With our innovative SDS sheet storage feature, accessing safety data sheets has never been easier.
Say goodbye to bulky binders and hello to convenient digital access. Stay compliant with confidence,
knowing your SDS forms are available offline even when internet is not available. Our user-friendly
interface ensures effortless navigation, allowing you to quickly locate and review SDS information
with just a few clicks. Experience peace of mind knowing that essential safety information is
readily available at your fingertips, empowering you to make informed decisions and maintain a safe
working environment.

[Learn More][25] [Book a Demo][26]
[desktop]
[mobile]

## CE Courses

Our platform offers essential trainings in OSHA, HIPAA, Infection Control, and more, tailored
specifically for dental offices. With each module, your staff can effortlessly access training
videos followed by interactive quizzes to ensure understanding. Upon completion, our system
automatically generates Continuing Education (CE) certificates, securely stored in individual staff
files. Stay compliant, stress-free, and focused on what matters most – providing exceptional care to
your patients.

challenge in many ways. Several offices I contacted were leery to allow swab testing in their
offices even though they said they felt confident of their disinfection process. My infection
control flag went up many times in those practices. If they felt confident, why are they leery of
doing a simple swab test? What was the risk to them? One office wanted to check with his lawyer,
wanted my license, and much more seeming ridiculous information. The offices that were welcoming
wanted to know how they could improve their infection prevention protocol. A big benefit was they
received bags of disposable valves for allowing testing of their disinfected valves.

Testing was done to determine if the valves were contaminated even after disinfection. What are the
consequences of the unknown invisible organic matter? What pathogens are nesting here? When
disinfected what pathogens are being reduced or present?

As an experienced infection prevention and safety specialist, I performed the swab-testing. After
reviewing the results, I was glad I had donned the appropriate PPE. Yet maybe I should have worn a
hazmat suit!

**Swab Test Case Study**

I was asked to perform an informal case study on dental office evacuation valves. This was a
challenge in many ways. Several offices I contacted were leery to allow swab testing in their
offices even though they said they felt confident of their disinfection process. My infection
control flag went up many times in those practices. If they felt confident, why are they leery of
doing a simple swab test? What was the risk to them? One office wanted to check with his lawyer,
wanted my license, and much more seeming ridiculous information. The offices that were welcoming
wanted to know how they could improve their infection prevention protocol. A big benefit was they
received bags of disposable valves for allowing testing of their disinfected valves.

Testing was done to determine if the valves were contaminated even after disinfection. What are the
consequences of the unknown invisible organic matter? What pathogens are nesting here? When
disinfected what pathogens are being reduced or present?

As an experienced infection prevention and safety specialist, I performed the swab-testing. After
reviewing the results, I was glad I had donned the appropriate PPE. Yet maybe I should have worn a
hazmat suit!

## Dental Amalgam Compliance and Regulations

Amalgam Separators and Cartridges

DRNA's Amalgam Separators and its line of Generic Cartridges satisfy all local, state, and federal
regulations for amalgam disposal and recycling. Furthermore, the DRNA Generic 1 cartridge was
successfully tested using the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit and met the ISO
11143:2008 standard.
* DRNA Generic Cartridge 1 is compatible with the Solmetex® Hg5® (Legacy) Amalgam Separator unit.
* EPA regulation requires cartridge replacement every year or once sediment reaches the fill line,
  whichever occurs sooner.
* DRNA makes replacement easy and hassle-free with on demand pick-up, recycling, and documentation
  included!

Scrap Amalgam Handling, Collection and Recycling

DRNA’s all-inclusive amalgam recycling service ensures that your office is able to effectively
manage all materials that fall under the category of “scrap amalgam.”
* Amalgam recycling kits come in 1.25 gallon, 2.5 gallon, or 5 gallon sizes.
* Amalgam Recycling Mail-back kit includes prepaid return label and all requisite compliance
  documentation.
* All amalgam wastes are recycled at an EPA-certified facility here in the United States.

Monitoring, Reporting and Record Keeping

All of DRNA’s products and services are supported by clear and accurate monitoring, reporting, and
record keeping in order to establish and evidence compliance. Dedicated monitoring and enforcement
is conducted by publicly owned treatment works (POTWs), local to your establishment.
* Adherence to all BMP’s and recycling of all scrap amalgam.
* Canisters, cartridges, or separator units are recycled in a timely manner, per manufacturer’s
  requirements

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

## Smarter solutions for a cleaner future

Experience tailored waste management services designed to simplify commercial waste disposal,

## Tailored waste solutions

Evirum delivers reliable, customized waste collection services tailored to your needs. Using 
equipment such as front-loading bins, rear-loading containers, roll-on bins, rear-loading
containers, roll-off bins, and semi-buried containers – we ensure efficient and dependable
collection of non-recyclable and non-compostable materials. Our team of green experts will recommend
the best solutions based on your materials, volume, and bin placement at your locations.

[Explore Waste Collection Services][6]

## Eco-friendly recycling

Transform materials like cardboard, paper, glass, and metals into valuable resources while keeping
them out of landfills and enhancing the material’s lifecycle. Designed for convenience, sorting bins
streamline the recycling process across offices, industrial facilities, retail spaces, and other
sectors, reducing environmental footprint and contamination of recycled materials all while helping
your business achieve its sustainability goals.

[Explore Corporate Recycling][7]

## Composting made simple

Turn food scraps and organic waste into nutrient-rich compost, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and
promoting a healthier planet. We provide sorting bins for easy separation of organic materials,
along with wheeled bins and front-load containers for efficient collection. Our pick-up services
ensure your organic waste is properly handled and processed.

Tired of missed pickups, confusing contracts, and endless rate comparisons? Leverage innovative
technology to personalize your waste management experience. We streamline the process, so you can
focus on your core business.

### Save time comparing providers

Gain peace of mind with reliable service, a digitized customer experience and timely issue

Navigate complex regulations effortlessly and avoid penalties. Be prepared for future changes such

Ensure the terms and conditions of your waste service contracts are fair and transparent. Avoid

## [ Kalkinhibierungsleistung von GREEN&CLEAN WK][105]

Eine aktuelle Laboruntersuchung zeigt: GREEN&CLEAN WK verhindert Kalkablagerungen bei Wasserhärten
bis 12° dH nahezu vollständig und reduziert sie selbst bei 20° dH deutlich. Damit steigert das
Produkt die Betriebssicherheit von Dentaleinheiten, schützt Leitungen und senkt den Wartungsaufwand.

## [Entdecken Sie META Sense!][107]

Der neue Chemiesensor META Sense im WEK-System misst täglich mehrfach die
Wasserstoffperoxid-Konzentration im Brauchwasser. Bei Abweichungen passt das System automatisch nach
– für konstante Hygienesicherheit. Alle Messwerte werden protokolliert, bis zu ein Jahr gespeichert
und können über die METASYS Software ausgewertet werden. Erfahren Sie mehr in unserem Video
[hier.][108]

  Prime DMS keeps your clinic aligned with every Ontario regulator - and tracks renewals, manuals,
  and training records on your behalf.

# Solmetex. Dental water solutions simplified.

Our trusted brands – Solmetex®, Sterisil® and DryShield® – work together as a complete, easy-to-use
system for managing the water in, through and out of your dental practice. We’re the only solution
you need to ensure safety, compliance, and peace of mind every step of the way.

[Shop our products][103]
[A dental hygienist smiles confidently]

## My Solutions Center™

[My Solution Center Login][104]

Don’t have an account? [Register now][105].

### Recycling Labels & Certificates

Print your recycling shipping labels and access recycling certificates to maintain EPA Dental
Amalgam Rule compliance.

### Monitor Dental Office Waterlines

Keep your water clean and safe! Log and retrieve water test results online. Our log of mail-in and
in-office waterline test results make it easy.

### Automate Product Deliveries

Create and manage product subscriptions for your dental practice and have them shipped direct from
your preferred distributor!

## Safe, clean water for your dental practice and for the environment.

> Water safety is very important to us because what goes into the patient’s mouth has to be clean
> and safe.
> 
> What really impresses me about the Solmetex® System of Water Solutions is its versatility. With a
> range of proven products, I was able to **customize my water management system** to meet the
> unique needs of my practice. Whether I needed a simple chairside filtration unit or a more
> comprehensive central filtration system, Solmetex® had the perfect the solution for me.
> 
> – Alex Vasserman, DMD

## It’s not just your water – it’s your waterlines.

**Dental waterlines can grow harmful bacteria. That’s why we created FASTCheck15™. It’s the quickest
and most affordable way to test your water.**

In just 15 minutes, you’ll know if your water is safe. No hassle, no waiting—just simple peace of
mind for your practice.

[Request a sample][106]

# Solmetex. Dental water solutions simplified.

Our trusted brands – Solmetex®, Sterisil® and DryShield® – work together as a complete, easy-to-use
system for managing the water in, through and out of your dental practice. We’re the only solution
you need to ensure safety, compliance, and peace of mind every step of the way.

[Shop our products][103]

## My Solutions Center™

### Recycling Labels & Certificates

Print your recycling shipping labels and access recycling certificates to maintain EPA Dental
Amalgam Rule compliance.

### Monitor Dental Office Waterlines

Keep your water clean and safe! Log and retrieve water test results online. Our log of mail-in and
in-office waterline test results make it easy.

### Automate Product Deliveries

Create and manage product subscriptions for your dental practice and have them shipped direct from
your preferred distributor!

## Safe, clean water for your dental practice and for the environment.

## It’s not just your water – it’s your waterlines.

**Dental waterlines can grow harmful bacteria. That’s why we created FASTCheck15™. It’s the quickest

In just 15 minutes, you’ll know if your water is safe. No hassle, no waiting—just simple peace of
mind for your practice.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

[Read More about Market Sizing and Forecasting][48]
[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

##### Telegram

Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.
